text:
ana csm: Spinning up a coordination thread for Cedar preview (org confirmed 6 seats). They want a tight enablement window and a short intake for compliance. Can we assign owners?

leo se: I'll provision the env in us-east-1 (they asked that region). Do we pre-provision API keys for their engineers or invite them to self-serve?

ana csm: Let's pre-provision 6 keys and label them cedar-seat-1..6, rotate after trial. We'll need SSO SCIM attributes from their IdP first.

maya enablement: I can run a 30m product walkthrough + 30m hands-on lab. Prefer to do EU-friendly time; propose Thu 9am UTC. Need their list of power users and 3 example workflows.

holden product: For the cohort we'll lock model build v2.0-beta (non-production) and enable logging to the sandbox metrics stream. If they hit token spikes we'll autoscale to burst pool.

marco ops-legal: Quick flag: Cedar mentioned PCI scope concerns for one workflow. We'll need to capture whether any PHI/PCI will be uploaded. If yes, escalate to privacy for gating.

leo se: Infra checklist: namespace cedar-preview, object-store mount read-only, request-rate limit 200rps, enable prefix cache + small KV retention (24h). Will stash their synthetic dataset in a pre-approved bucket if they sign DPA addendum.

devops-bot: terraform apply completed for namespace cedar-preview (apply-id: tf-cedar-2026-04-02) — LB config, metrics exporter, and alerting policy deployed.

maya enablement: Training plan: 1) 15m expectations + success metrics 2) 30m guided lab 3) 15m Q&A. I'll prepare a 1-page pre-read and a shared dojo repo with sample prompts. Need the sample prompts by Wed EOD.

ana csm: I'll send intake: fields = "primary outcome", "top KPI (1-3)", "sample prompts (up to 8)", "data classification (public/internal/confidential)", "SSO admin email".

marco ops-legal: Also include a checkbox: "Will you upload customer data or logs?" If yes, require sign-off from security and DPA.

holden product: Canary plan: route 10% traffic to v2.0-beta with fallback to v1.9. Add perf sentinel: 95p latency < 450ms, error rate < 0.5%.

leo se: API key provisioning flow: I'll generate keys and save them in org vault; send invites to their eng leads. Also will export 2 console screenshots (namespace view + per-route cost) for Maya's deck.

maya enablement: Great — screenshots + sample prompts will let me build the lab. I'll also ask for 2 folks to be able to SSH to the sandbox for troubleshooting.

ana csm: Risk notes: Potential renewal risk areas = SSO SCIM sync reliability, data classification mismatch, and latency at peak. I'll note for account exec to follow.

holden product: If latency appears in canary we'll enable a quantized lighter model option and update the billing projection.

devops-bot: alert: sandbox CPU spike observed during test deploy (2026-04-02T14:12Z) — normalized after scale-up.

leo se: Noted spike — I'll tweak autoscale threshold and bump burst pool.

maya enablement: Action items recap: 1) ana send intake (today). 2) leo stand up env + keys + screenshots (tomorrow). 3) maya prepare deck + dojo (Thu 9am UTC). 4) marco capture compliance checkbox and review if customer indicates PCI/PHI. 5) holden monitor canary metrics and enable fallbacks.

ana csm: Thanks team. I'll post intake link here once sent and add seat invite list. :white_check_mark:
